artifact: prompt payload asymmetry, CORD-v2 validation (100 receipts)
method: exact character counts over the project's own prompt rendering (text_task.from_cord_gt rule); no model, no sampling — reproducible from the public dataset by anyone
honest_framing_REQUIRED: This is a COST statement, not a quality statement. It says what adaptation saves per request IF quality holds — and quality is exactly what the gates test. Until a gate passes, the only claimable sentence is: 'the k-shot baseline pays this payload ratio on every request; adaptation pays it once.' Never quote this ratio without the gate status next to it.
units_caveat: Characters, not tokens — token ratios vary by tokenizer but track document length closely at this scale. Chars chosen so the number is verifiable without any model dependency.
